notes.title: First 'powapowa' patch for Harmonia
notes.content:
Bugfixes:

・Fixed some typos and translation errors 
・Fixed missing voice file in Chapter 2
・Fixed Steam Cloud settings

Due to script related patches some save files might not be working anymore.
We apologize for the inconvenience.


Finally, we want to thank the Kazamatsuri community and Kuzu for helping us with this first patch.
